scopeLabel: Source-scoped InP core and InP/ZnSe/ZnS multishell preparation, ligand transfer, streptavidin/chitosan coupling, biological specimen preparation, and distinct source-reported characterization and control contexts. All eleven main and four matching supporting-information pages were read as text and images. Printed ambiguities, unspecified preparation settings, and unknown physical batch joins remain explicit. This is not a complete laboratory SOP or a full-paper narrative Reader.

availability.morphology_illustration: Source figures and reported dimensions are retained. bindings.caption: Acquire the fluorescence time trace. Continuous-wave excitation and sCMOS recording. Exposure and frame rate are separate source settings; absent per-panel quantities are not inferred. Illustration is an instrument/action cue, not a simulated experimental trace. The common method uses a Nikon Si-oil immersion objective, Hamamatsu C5440-20UP sCMOS camera and ET500LP emission filter. The general camera rate is 30 fps; per-panel frame rates are only asserted where explicitly reported. Qualified action illustration; no unreported vessel dimensions, hardware, measured molecular geometry, or experimental trace is implied.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
